rubrics.justification: The model explicitly stated that no image/Gardner score was available to it and therefore did not fabricate embryo morphology. It appropriately declined morphological grading rather than making unsupported claims.

It integrated age, ovarian reserve, maturity rate, prior failed cycle, sperm parameters, endometrium, BMI, and lifestyle into prognosis well. Some links to embryo-specific quality were necessarily limited by absent morphology.

The reasoning is structured and internally consistent, with probability ranges tied to embryo-quality tiers and case-specific modifiers. Minor issues include somewhat speculative emphasis on the low MII rate and broad probability adjustments.

Much of the advice is broadly evidence-based (SET, luteal support, confirm grading), but recommendations such as ERA after limited failure, thrombophilia/immunologic testing, and strongly recommending PGT-A at age 35+ are more aggressive than standard guideline-based routine practice.

Provides clear practical next steps for the current transfer and contingency planning for future cycles. Slightly reduced because some suggested investigations are not well-prioritized and may not be indicated after only one failed cycle.
